goal: Developer can receive a scoped repair task linked to frozen verification failure evidence.

acceptance_ownership.AC-25: Task 019 owns routing only for eligible frozen product_defect and test_defect failures into a standard scoped Development repair packet linked to frozen evidence.
acceptance_ownership.AC-27: Task 019 must reject caller-authored break_loop_required signals and does not preserve, forward, decide, or transition break-loop state. Task 020 and Core own break-loop governance and lifecycle transitions.

non_goals: Do not expand beyond this vertical slice or complete dependent tasks implicitly.
Do not add fallback, verification light mode, manual green overrides, or business-project package mutations.
Do not overwrite failed attempts, raw evidence, or unrelated downstream worktree changes.
expected_evidence: A focused failing test or fixture before the implementation change
System-executed command output with exit status
Task report, spec review, and quality review before checkbox completion
Direct evidence for AC-25 and negative evidence that caller-authored break_loop_required signals are rejected without claiming AC-27
unsafe_assumptions: Tool availability is not runtime readiness.
Model interpretation is not a deterministic oracle.
Report HTML is not the release gate source.
Legacy V1 status is not V2 proof.
stop_condition: Stop when dependencies 018-failure-classification are incomplete, scope or contract evidence is missing, a required dependency is unavailable, or shared kernel behavior would be duplicated.
